description: Only when the person asks to order or what a report costs: our order page with the report and countries filled in, and the fee (Country $99, Enhanced $129 for two countries, Global $149 for three or more countries). The page leads to payment, which opens only if the person pays there. Send no personal details.

countries.description: The countries to order for, as names or ISO codes, for example ["NL", "United Kingdom"]. Any country we can read can be ordered.

language.description: Optional. Language of our own sentences, default en: en, ar, da, de, es, fa, fr, hi, id, it, ja, ko, nb, nl, pl, pt, pt-BR, ro, ru, sv, th, tl, tr, zh, vi, uk, bg. Facts stay as stored.

tier.description: "country" (one country), "enhanced" (two countries) or "global" (three or more countries, in one report).

name: create_order_link
title: Get an order link for a report
